markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (100%)** · Confident · Careful review
Only Invasive is in the 90% set, and every agreement check matches [F1]; worklist tier 2.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 100%, InSitu 0% | Strongly one-sided |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | Reliability 100%; OOD pct 100 | Input flag off |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Invasive [F5] | Unanimous neighbors |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 2, 7, 10) · ↑ invasive · Scored above typical; strongest concept association [F2] · Validated
- **Scarce gland formation** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Low score; region 11 is least low [F4] · Validated
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 0, 3, 8) · ↑ invasive · High score across all 12 regions · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 3, 5, 9) · ↑ invasive · Scored high but failed spot check, 0/20 [F3] · Unreliable
- **Nuclear size** (regions 2, 3, 9) · context · Mean 42 µm², lowest in reference set; variation 90th percentile [F7] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to classifier.
- **Concepts**: Concept deletion differs from random by 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007), including 0; not shown to reflect the classifier. This case leans on mitoses (Unreliable).

## Could be wrong if
- The 100% rests on a small test set (132 images; ECE 0.05, CI 0.03–0.18).
- Regions 2, 3, 9 are unrepresentative; nuclear size there is lowest in the reference set.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 2, 7, 10:** confirm stromal invasion, the strongest and best-validated association.
2. **Regions 0, 3, 8:** confirm marked pleomorphism despite the low mean nuclear size.
3. **Region 11:** gland-formation score least low here; check for benign glands or in situ component.
